mechanical_civil.civil_quantity_basis: Each elevated segment is separate; 25 m catalogue span, up to 4 spans/unit from the shared production/continuity templates, two tracks and two webs. Shared bearings require an unaccepted structural continuity connection; a simple-span link slab retains independent girder-end bearings. Rounded spans are a procurement screen, not surveyed support positions. Deck gaps count the existing catalogue unit interfaces; abutment details remain separate.

civil_movement: complete deployment train axle positions and loaded distribution
component temperature extremes and erection temperature
selected connection load path, construction stages and bearing restraint
rail interaction, seismic and foundation movement
surveyed supports and abutment movement details
cleaning: measured washable area by material, not canopy area
trial person-minutes, water and safe access windows
wash-water collection and local disposal route
fasteners: preload loss, slip/separation, bearing and thread checks
finishes: local exposure and substrate preparation qualification
approved product system and batch TDS limits
seals: supplier qualified compression range and ageing
actual thickness, land gap and tolerances
water-ingress test after assembly and cleaning

mechanical_civil.soil_use: Prioritise investigation and settlement/drainage monitoring; mapped pH/texture do not determine bearing resistance, pile depth, sulfate/chloride exposure or a coating category.
mechanical_civil.thermal_basis: Free movement alpha*L*deltaT. 8/10/12 microstrain/K are declared sensitivity cases, not measured concrete properties. Reference is the preset annual mean, not installation temperature; sunlit component temperatures and gradients require separate inputs.

finance_basis.basis: Two continuously covered station posts; annual productive hours and graded country-income proxy wages. Indicative FTE, not an accepted roster.

open_work: named duty and leave roster including service-depot turnaround crews
measured cleaning/inspection person-minutes and simultaneous arrivals
country/local pay and actual grade costs
local employment/rest requirements and night emergency cover

policy.basis: Budget-neutral allocation of existing GoA 4 labour groups; local staffing proposal, not a measured workload or accepted roster.
shared_country_capabilities: specialist laboratory, structural/geotechnical checking and training
policy.shared_service_rule: Shared domestic capability: allocate factory staff/cost across actual city orders; do not duplicate a national factory headcount in every city.
